demo.morningHint: Reset the mission to the seeded morning.
demo.headacheHint: Adds the headache report and the cabin sensor reading.
demo.watchHint: Jumps to 20 seconds before the watch raises the alarm.

check.label: Daily check · {n} of {total}
check.prefilled: Showing your last value. Change it if today is different.
check.typeHint: Type the number or use the keypad. Enter goes to the next one.
check.scaleHint: Tap an answer, or press a number from 1 to 5.
check.tapZone: Tap a body zone to see what feeds it.
check.noIndicators: Nothing is measured for this zone yet.

findings.title: Findings
findings.none: Nothing needs your attention right now.
findings.noneHint: KAWSAY cross-checks your readings every time one comes in.
findings.onBoard: Resolved on board — no need to wait for Earth.
findings.escalates: This one also goes to the flight surgeon.
findings.gotIt: Got it, I'll do it today
findings.noted: Noted at {time}. We'll look again at tomorrow's check.
findings.ifNotText: KAWSAY adds this to the flight surgeon brief and keeps watching.

brief.heading: Brief · Day {day} · {crew}
brief.readyText: One screen, readable in 30 seconds. Goes out with the next downlink.
brief.queuedText: Nothing new since {time}. A new brief is built when something changes.
brief.conjunctionText: Brief stored on this device. KAWSAY keeps the loop running on board.
brief.nothingChanged: Nothing changed since the last brief.
brief.footerDecision: Earth's answer cannot arrive before {time}. Keep following the steps on board.

environment.hint: Sets gravity and the delay to Earth used by the brief.

watch.title: Watch data
watch.todayHint: Heart rate through the day, with what you were doing underneath. A knot marks each alert.
watch.cannotHint: They come from your daily check.
rules: Heart rate 110 or more while resting, for 1 min · Watch
Heart rate 110 or more while resting, for 5 min · Act
Heart rate 130 or more while resting, for 2 min · Act now
Heart rate below 40 while awake and resting, for 5 min · Act
Blood oxygen below 92 % for 3 min · Act
Blood oxygen below 88 % for 1 min · Act now
watch.rulesNote: These limits are prototype values, not NASA figures. A high heart rate during exercise is not an alert.
watch.noAlerts: No alerts so far. Your watch is checking every 5 seconds.
watch.bandLive: Heart rate from your band · other signals simulated

alarm.countdown: No answer in {time} and KAWSAY alerts the crew.
alarm.usual: Your usual resting rate is {low} to {high}.

respond.notRuledOut: Not ruled out: a rhythm problem. If it does not settle, the crew medical officer and Earth are told.
respond.recheckHint: Stay resting. Keep the watch on.
respond.dontWait: Earth is {min} minutes away. Do not wait for the answer to act.
respond.noEarth: No contact with Earth during conjunction. The crew medical officer decides.

connect.title: Connect your band
connect.intro: Pair a heart-rate band so the Watch shows your real pulse. Bluetooth only: it works with no internet.
connect.noneHint: Until you connect one, the Watch plays the demo mission.

no-api.title: Bluetooth is not available here
no-api.hint: Open KAWSAY in Chrome or Edge, or use the desktop app.

insecure.title: Bluetooth needs a secure page
insecure.hint: Open KAWSAY from its https address or from the desktop app.

off.title: Bluetooth is off
off.hint: Turn on Bluetooth on this computer, then try again.

readyList: Bluetooth is on on this computer.
The band is charged, on your wrist and within 1 m.
Turn off Bluetooth on your phone. The band keeps one Bluetooth link at a time, and the phone app takes it.
Xiaomi Mi Band 4, 5 or 6: have the band key ready. Xiaomi Smart Band 7 and newer use a different key check that KAWSAY does not support yet.
connect.readyNote: Next, a list of nearby devices opens. Pick your band.
connect.waitingHint: No reading yet. On a Xiaomi Smart Band 7, start a workout on the band: it shares heart rate only while it measures.
connect.staleHint: Tighten the strap, one finger above the wrist bone.
connect.onlyHr: The band shares heart rate only. Blood oxygen, breathing, skin temperature and HRV on the Watch still come from the demo series.

cancelled.title: No device chosen
cancelled.hint: Open the list again and pick your band.

no-hr-service.title: This band does not share heart rate
no-hr-service.hint: It connected but offered no standard heart-rate service. A Xiaomi Smart Band 7 may need its pairing key for that. Use a chest strap or the demo data.

failed.title: Could not connect
failed.hint: Move closer, check the band is not connected to your phone, and try again.

lost.title: Band disconnected
lost.hint: It stopped answering. Bring it closer and try again.

needs-key.title: This Xiaomi band needs its key
needs-key.hint: Mi Band 4, 5 and 6 share heart rate only after a key check. Paste the band key below.

wrong-key.title: The band rejected the key
wrong-key.hint: Check the key. It changes when the band is reset or paired again on the phone.

auth-refused.title: The band refused the connection
auth-refused.hint: Turn off Bluetooth on your phone, then try again.

connect.prototype: Link limits are prototype values: old after 5 s without a reading, disconnected after 30 s.
connect.keyHint: Saved only on this computer. Chest straps and other bands do not need it.
connect.keyInvalid: That is not a band key. It has 32 characters, 0–9 and a–f.
keyHelp: The band never sends its key over Bluetooth, so it has to be fetched once from your account (internet needed one time).
Easiest: run  node tools/get-band-key.mjs  and sign in with the account the band is bound to; it prints a 0x… key to paste here.
Band on a Xiaomi phone account? Use the browser method in tools/README-band-key.md.
Do not reset or re-pair the band afterwards: that changes the key. From then on KAWSAY needs only Bluetooth.
No key at all: a standard Bluetooth chest strap (Polar, CooSpo, Wahoo…) works here with no account.
connect.pickHint: Not in the list? Turn off Bluetooth on your phone and tap the band screen to wake it.
